mission.title: Why ODALX
mission.runeOdal: Odal (ᛟ) — the legacy: what is inherited and passed on.
mission.runeGebo: Gebo (ᚷ) — the gift: what is offered in return.
mission.p1: ODALX is born from the union of two runes: Odal and Gebo. The name says what the brand does: inherit knowledge — read, study, fail, accumulate — and give it away — open source, documentation, tools others actually use.
mission.p2: While I study and teach myself, this is the laboratory where products are born from curiosity: a bot that learns from markets, a memory that never forgets, an ERP that scales.
mission.quote: Build knowledge that gets inherited, and share it as a gift.
